kin.text: Quiet. You're here, so speak. The Fourfold Threshold chose you for us. Now the Hollowing is chewing at the edges of the dream, and The Unseen Covenant needs hands that can do what yours can.

options.text: Tell me about The Unseen Covenant.

offer.text: Use what you are. There are seals in this meadow only our calling can open, and things out there that need answering. Do it, then come back.

progress.text: Check your journal, then go. The seals won't open themselves.

rewarded.text: Well done. You are one of us in more than name now. Take this — and the vault of The Unseen Covenant is yours to open.

lore.text: The Covenant was the first to wake when the Root closed her eyes. They keep the Key of Shadows in a place that doesn't exist on maps.

stranger.text: Hm. A stranger in Duskhollow. Either very brave or very lost. You are not of our calling. But the dream is wide, and goodwill is a kind of door.

options.text: How do I earn your trust?
Here — I brought what you asked.

goodwill.text: Bring us 3 crone tooths. Small things build bridges. Large things build bigger ones.

options.text: I'll see what I can find.

goodwill_done.text: ...You actually did it. The Unseen Covenant will remember.
